up: Find all distinct molecules that are associated with the document whose ChEMBL ID is 'CHEMBL1142268'. For each such molecule, return its ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (pref_name), the maximum development phase (max_phase), the molecule type (e.g., 'Small molecule', 'Antibody'), and the canonical SMILES. Order the results by the molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1142268' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
